svg.text: CHAPTER THREE · ONE PHOTOGRAPH, ALL THE WAY THROUGH
A photo is never classified. Every face in it is.
Follow one photograph, taken at 11pm, from the camera roll to the database.

After step 4 the photograph is never looked at again.
Everything that follows — finding you, grouping people, searching a gallery — is arithmetic on those 512 numbers.
